issues.explanation: The INSO standard is cited throughout the section exclusively as 'INSO 23681:1403' without its international counterpart ISO/IEC 23053:2022 (confirmed identical adoption per I23681-id: «Identical with ISO/IEC 23053:2022»). Hard content rule 6 requires both identifiers whenever an INSO document is referenced, so that readers cannot conflate the national adoption with the international text. The requirement applies to the first substantive mention; later clause references may use the short form.
issues.quote: برداشت اجرایی تدوینگر از مفاهیم INSO 23681:1403
issues.suggested_fix: Change the first mention to «برداشت اجرایی تدوینگر از مفاهیم INSO 23681:1403 (≡ ISO/IEC 23053:2022)». In the body, references such as «بندهای ۶.۴، ۸.۳ و ۸.۵ استاندارد» and «در بندهای ۶.۵.۵.۱ و ۸.۵ آمده است» may keep the short form after the first full citation is established.
